scope: All nine completed 200-frame smoke arms; independent actual-file hash and input-ledger verification. Formal benchmark scope remains partial: no 17-sequence scores are established by this audit. No GPU, source mutation or evaluation.
GT_guard_limit: These guards intercept Python builtins.open/io.open/os.open for paths resolving under the configured annotation root in that inference process. They are not syscall, native-library, subprocess, alternative-path or comprehensive IO absence proofs.

verified_source_behavior: Rehashes all frozen sources/models and the separate identity/reference CPU receipts; requires actual terminal smoke exit zero.
Requires nine manifest-ordered global smoke records of one sequence and 200 frames each.
Rehashes actual prediction files, reads actual runtime reports, checks runtime operators, recomputes the ordered per-frame and rolling input ledger, and compares every arm ledger.
Requires actual problem frame186 detector SHA and all actual corrected-reference or candidate-legal counters through audit_runtime.
Writes a manifest-bound resolved sealed identity gate only after these checks; full runner verifies that gate and rehashes all its evidence before launching formal arms.
nonblocking_integrity_boundaries: Sealer does not parse each local arm receipt and compare it with the global summary; it records the local file SHA. This independent audit actually parsed them and confirms all nine equal.

Sealer does not separately re-read raw GT guard files or same-process hardware logs. This independent audit verifies each raw guard/log equals the recorded object, with all model SHA values and command model paths also checked.
Sealer does not compare global record runtime_totals with actual runtime counts; this independent audit confirms equality for all nine arms.

known_postprocessing_issue.issue: E00/E01 arm dictionaries omit bundle_sha256 while analyze_completed.py accesses it directly; the authoritative global manifest frozen_files_sha256 contains both correct model hashes.
known_postprocessing_issue.impact: The frozen final analyzer will raise KeyError after full completion unless root introduces a separately versioned postprocessing compatibility solution. This is not an observed smoke model or metadata mismatch.
